This artifact could not be opened. Check its format and size.
Allow a one-time download of Pyodide from its pinned CDN? Python runs locally after download. Your code and chat are not sent to the CDN.

Allow this version to load public HTTPS scripts, images and styles? Resource addresses can disclose artifact content to external sites. Scripts run inside this preview. Access ends when you change versions, run again or close the preview. Forms, navigation, files and device access stay blocked.

Switch accounts yourself. Quota and rate errors never switch accounts. Unfinished tasks require their original account.
Delete this saved credential? Deleting the selected account signs it out without selecting another.
Could not update accounts. Check the label, key and account limit.
Restricted browser for public pages and simple forms. Site scripts, login, passwords and downloads are blocked. Take over to scroll, enter text or approve navigation yourself.
Action completed. Read the page again to inspect its current contents and targets.
Browser action blocked or failed. Check the page, target and connection.
Review the page, destination and exact fields below. Approval expires if the page changes. No login or password entry is allowed.

Allow this connector to search and read for this chat? The request below runs first; later reads in this chat will not ask again. Disconnect or restart the app to revoke this grant. No write operations are available.

Connect a read-only cloud or mail API. You sign in in your system browser. The first call asks for access for this chat. Disconnect deletes the local token; revoke server access in the provider account too.

Use a public OAuth client with S256 PKCE and a loopback redirect on 127.0.0.1 at a dynamic port, path /oauth/callback. Search and read must use the same HTTPS origin. Choose only read-only scopes. Responses are JSON or text; redirects are refused. No client secret is needed or stored.
Connector setup or sign-in failed. Verify the public-client PKCE configuration and read-only endpoints, or sign in again after token expiry.

Optional: sends recent messages from up to three saved chats and your saved facts to the selected provider for suggestions after an answer. This uses extra API calls. Temporary chats are excluded. Nothing changes until you approve each suggestion.
Memory suggestions could not be updated. If you edited a fact, reject its old suggestion and request a fresh one after a chat.

Scheduled prompts run when Android permits, without tools or notifications. Times are approximate; repeats are at least 15 minutes apart. Reopen the app after a reboot or force-stop. API use may cost money.

Approve sending this prompt later using the current account and model. Repeating tasks keep running until cancelled. If you switch accounts, the task reports an error instead of switching back. Results stay in the Tasks inbox.
This task did not run because its original account is no longer selected. Select that account manually and schedule again, or wait for the next repeat.
This run was interrupted. It will not resend automatically to avoid duplicate API charges. Schedule again if needed.
The scheduled prompt failed. Check your connection, account, quota and model in Settings. No account was switched.
Could not update the task. Check credentials, timing and the 50 active task limit.
Sign-in received. Return to DeepSeek Android.
The sign-in callback was invalid. Return to DeepSeek Android and try again.

Speak to send each turn. Tap to interrupt. Leaving the app pauses voice. Recognition uses your system speech service, which may use its network. Answers use installed offline English or Bangla voices.
Speech could not play. Check the installed offline voice for this language in Android text-to-speech settings, and try again when other audio has stopped.
This image will be sent with your next spoken turn.
This model reads text only. Only text extracted from this image will be sent with your next spoken turn. OCR may not recognize Bangla text.
Open the target app with exactly these details? You must finish sending or saving there. Opening a map may send the place query to your maps provider. Calendar times below are epoch milliseconds.
Opened the target app. The user must finish the action there.
No compatible app could open this draft or action. Nothing was sent or saved.

Capture only this app window once? Android 10 and later require extra foreground-service permissions to capture other apps, so that is unavailable here. You will review the image before attaching it. Nothing is sent automatically.
Allow one screenshot through the Android consent screen? Capture works only while this app is visible, stops after one image, and cannot read protected content. Review it before attaching.
The screenshot could not be captured. Keep this app visible and try again.

Return to the app and confirm this action again. No phone app was opened.
